Class BotBrain

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.server.BotBrain
public final class BotBrain extends Object
The scripted mind of the sparring bot. The body is a Carpet fake player, so everything it does goes through real player physics and the real attack code; this class only decides where to look, which way to walk and when to swing.

  • Field Details

    • TIMER_COUNTS

      public static final AtomicIntegerArray TIMER_COUNTS
      For the training log, from the one that plays on the agent's rhythm (BotProfile.timer): jumps timed for the agent's sword, jumps that met the agent arriving, critical hits that came of each, and how many of either jump the agent hit it out of. Read and cleared by the trainer, which in a world of one's own runs in the same game.

    • CRIT_JUMP_REACH

      private static final double CRIT_JUMP_REACH
      It only jumps for a crit from this near. A jump takes seven ticks to its way down, and the agent does not wait for it; from the edge of its reach (which is where it jumped from up to 0.13.0) the agent was mostly gone by then, and the bot came down having hit nothing.

      void setLag(int ticks)
      How many ticks late it sees the agent, as a player on a server would. It aims at, walks up to and swings at the agent where that was; a swing that connects there lands on the agent where it is now, which to the agent is being hit from where it had already left.
